features.quote: 40 turns per trial (hard ceiling). The system loop forcibly terminates at turn 40
features.justification_quote: This is sufficient to observe degradation patterns while remaining computationally tractable.

features.quote: A trial terminates early (before turn 40) if: - `submit_solution()` is called
Model produces 5 consecutive empty tool calls (likely stuck)
Model produces identical output for 3 consecutive turns (hard loop)
